verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with a CLI, SDK and cloud service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting is a related deployment option, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
